description: Creates a DRAFT campaign email in the visual editor, in the store’s own look (logo, colours, fonts), from copy you write: subject, preview text, heading, paragraphs, a button; optionally a layout, a discount code and product cards. Don’t start with a greeting unless you want one there: PuffinMail doesn’t add one. It goes to the main list, or a segment if you give one (use list_segments or create_segment). It is never scheduled or sent: the store owner reviews it in PuffinMail and sends it. Returns its link.

accent.description: Button colour as #rrggbb. Leave it out to use the store’s own.

big_text.description: The offer in giant type, e.g. "30% OFF" (offer and dark layouts).

button_label.description: Call-to-action button text, e.g. "Shop the sale" (default "Shop now").

button_url.description: Where the button goes: a full https URL on the store’s own website (get_workspace’s website, with or without www), no Liquid (default: the store’s home page).

code.description: A discount code, shown in a dashed box. Only one the store has ALREADY created in its shop (PuffinMail doesn’t make codes); never invent one.

heading.description: The headline at the top of the email.

kicker.description: A short line above the heading, e.g. "This weekend only"; the strip layout’s bar.

layout.description: The design, always in the store’s own look (logo, colours, fonts). Omit for a plain email: logo, heading, copy, code, products, button. banner: headline in a band of the brand colour. offer: the offer in giant type (big_text) and a wide button. dark: a black "night" look, made for Black Friday. hero: the store’s main picture across the top. panel: copy and code in a soft brand-coloured panel. letter: a personal, left-aligned note signed by the team. grid: product-led, six products. strip: an urgent bar across the top (kicker) for deadlines.

name.description: Internal name only the owner sees, e.g. "Winter steak sale" (default: the subject).

paragraphs.description: 1 to 4 short paragraphs of plain text (no HTML). PuffinMail adds NO greeting: to greet, start the first paragraph with "Hi {{ contact.first_name | default: "there" }}," (many contacts have no first name; never write a real name). The only other Liquid allowed anywhere is {{ shop.name }} and {{ shop.url }}; anything else is refused.

preheader.description: Preview text after the subject in inboxes, under 100 characters.

product_count.description: How many products, two to a row: 2, 4 or 6 (default 4; 6 in the grid layout).

products.description: Product cards (picture, name, price, button) from the store’s catalogue, filled in live when it’s sent; list_products shows what they’ll be (default none).

segment_id.description: Only send to this segment of the main list (from list_segments or create_segment).
